sources.entry: C: _Build Your Own Lisp: Learn C and build your own programming language in 1000 lines of code_

summary.title: Build Your Own Lisp
summary.one_liner: Learn C while building your own Lisp-style programming language in about 1000 lines of code.
takeaways: Learn the basics of the C language by writing real code
Understand the nature of Lisp languages
Build a small programming language from scratch in about 1000 lines of C
Practice developing a real-world project and writing concise, clean code
summary.summary: Build Your Own Lisp is a free online book that teaches the C programming language by having the reader build their own Lisp-like programming language. The page describes the goal as roughly 1000 lines of code and says the book covers the nature of Lisps and how to develop a real-world project. It also notes that a print edition and e-book versions are available for purchase. The page text is mostly introductory, so it does not list chapter-level details.
